name: cinemaabyss-api-tests
description: API tests for CinemaAbyss microservices architecture

scripts.test:docker: docker run --rm --network cinemaabyss-network cinemaabyss-api-tests node run-tests.js --environment docker
scripts.test:events: node run-tests.js --folder "Events Microservice" --env-var movieId=1 --env-var userId=1 --env-var paymentId=1
scripts.test:e2e:docker: docker run --rm --network cinemaabyss-network cinemaabyss-api-tests node run-tests.js --collection CinemaAbyss_E2E --environment docker
